CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to same content present.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates (red/blue) and an explicit origin/status are provided for the same referent/time, indicating identified content, its organization/presentation and a separate status attribute.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to the identified contents' presentation/access is stated.

C.rationale: Multiple entries explicitly identify content sets (red/blue) tied to named referents and times.

D.rationale: Origins/status metadata are separately attributed to identified referents, distinguishing content identity from its source/status.

O.rationale: Explicit coordinate sets and candidate/current labels state how contents are organized/presented for specific referents/times.
